note:
**The meaning of the verse**
﴿وَتَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ﴾
… And cooperate, O believers, among yourselves in doing good and in fearing Allah, and do not cooperate in what involves sin, disobedience and overstepping Allah's limits. And beware of going against Allah's command, for He is severe in punishment.

📖 At-Tafsir Al-Muyassar — King Fahd Complex.

**Talk with your child**
1. What did the men say at the gap? Was there any lie in what they said? So why did the water keep running away into the soil?
2. Suhail owned nothing in the field, and he could not do what the men could do. So why did he climb down into the channel? And who climbed down after him?
3. Do we help our friends with everything they ask? (No, we cooperate only in what is good, for the verse says: ﴿وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ﴾ (and do not cooperate in sin and aggression), so we do not help a friend to cheat or to hurt anyone.)

**This week's exercise**
This week your child looks for something at home or in the building that does not belong to them alone and needs fixing: toys scattered in a shared room, shoes in a mess by the door, or papers in the entrance. They start on it without being asked, and then you both watch: did anyone follow?
